'operator': the configured operator-grade one-sigma ephemeris (RIC 100/1000/1000 m, 0.02/0.02/0.05 m/s); 'tle': every satellite at the TLE-grade sigmas (2/20/10 km, 0.3/0.3/0.7 m/s). 'calibrated-guam': differenced against the configured Guam reference (shared-1); 'calibrated-nearest-whatif': the same reference design moved to the nearest of the what-if sites. Distances in m; semi-major of the 95 % ellipse; CEP50 of P_total.
